coreMemory.english: n. what happens because of an action；v. to happen because of something else
coreMemory.structure: as a result /æz ə rɪˈzʌlt/（因此）；result in /rɪˈzʌlt ɪn/（导致）；result from /rɪˈzʌlt frʌm/（由……引起）；test results /tɛst rɪzʌlts/（测试结果）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use result with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of result in context；❌ translate result word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “as a result”

commonErrors.wrong: use result with the same article in every context

commonErrors.right: check the countability of result in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv rɪˈzʌlt ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “as a result”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz æz ə rɪˈzʌlt/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。

coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词
